title: Mixed Event — What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic! — Episode7 Unexpected Support

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!
meta.Event Outline: Noticing Mizuki's lackluster attitude following the mystery tour, Ena grows worried. Her apparent concern for her friend doesn't go unnoticed by Airi and Shizuku, who extend an invitation to a picnic to both of them in hopes of lifting their spirits.

rows.Line: Hiking Trail

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Achoo!!
This rain isn't doing us any favors...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ena and Airi might catch a cold if they stay exposed like this. I'm worried about Mizuki too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, I need to be more positive...!
We need to save them before the rain gets worse. Is there anything I can do right now to help...?
<Oh, is this a bad time...?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, this voice... Was that...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Shizuku, it sounded like you're in quite a bit of trouble...!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Luka...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
W-We are!
Ena and Airi fell down a ledge...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mizuki went off to go look for help, but I haven't been able to do anything for them. It's raining too, so if we don't do something soon, Ena and Airi might...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Don't worry, Shizuku. We can think of a way to help them together.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Luka... Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You said they fell, but can they still move around?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe so. Airi said she scraped her knee, but that was about it. Still, I'm incredibly concerned...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I see... We do need to act fast...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we do. I was hoping that I'd be able to just pull them back up, but they were too far away. If only we had a rope or something...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Do you have anything that can act as a rope?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, I was carrying the tarp and towels. Oh, a change of clothes too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But these wouldn't be long enough even if we did turn them into a rope somehow...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What if I tied them all together?
Then they might be long enough...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Great idea! Do you know how to tie the right knots?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I think I still do. I learned how to for an educational show once. Do you think this will work...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I believe in you.
I'm sure you can do it, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thanks, Luka...!
I'll give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's really starting to come down. That ledge is gonna be way too wet to climb up now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do we do? It'll be dark soon too...! If we can't get back up, does that mean we'll...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saying stuff like that isn't gonna help us get out of this. We have to keep trying and come up with a way to get out of here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But we've already tried everything!
What else can we possibly do?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Gasp*...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, Airi. It's all my fault for slipping and falling down here in the first place...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ena, enough...!
Just try thinking about your art or something for now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? My art?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Back in junior high, your dad told you that you don't have any talent, but you kept on drawing! You never gave up!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even after you couldn't get into that art school, even as no one appreciated your art, you kept going!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You overcame all those things and never gave up! You're a fighter, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So buck up!
We have to believe in Mizuki too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll be fine! I promise to be right back with help!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Believe in...
Yeah, I'm sure Mizuki will...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, you guys!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, was that Mizuki's voice...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm back!! I brought help too!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank goodness. Looks like everything will be okay now♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I think so...!
Oh, right! I need to put you away for now, Luka...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, but I'll still be here with you until Ena and Airi are back safe with you.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You two, over here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is this where your friends fell, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa, that's pretty steep...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I do have some rope on me, but it may not be long enough...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, please feel free to use this...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Did you make this, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I did. If you tie it together with that rope of yours, I'm sure we can use it to save them!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nice work, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You've tied these together very well.
I believe this will do...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, let me tie the other end of the rope to here and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, everyone... Pull!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: W-We made it... I thought we were goners...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The rain really didn't help, but great work hanging in there, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You too, Airi. I don't even want to think about what might've happened if Mizuki and Shizuku weren't here either...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi! Ena!
Thank goodness you're safe...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm relieved too but exhausted at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You two really saved our skins there. I'm not sure we'll ever be able to pay you back for this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, don't worry about that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And we need to thank these two for saving us as well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What, us?
We're just glad that you're safe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It looks like you can still walk too. We'll lead you back to the rest area.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm glad everything worked out. I'll be heading back now, Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for your help, Luka. And I'm sorry about not getting a chance to show you this wonderful landscape...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, don't mind me.
I'll see you later, okay♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, see you in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Did you just say something, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, I was just talking to myself...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll have to apologize to everyone that came on this tour too. They're probably worried sick about us...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but how...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For now, let's just be glad that we're all okay. After we get back, we can get some well deserved rest...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wasn't that your favorite outfit?
I feel terrible about it getting ruined like that. I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What, this? I did like it, but I can just buy something else, right? More importantly...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're safe now and that's what matters most.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And you're not hurt at all?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm fine, really...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
This barely counts as a scratch!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, Airi...
Just promise to get it checked after we head home, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, please do. You might not even know something's wrong until days later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, okay, I'll go! I promise...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I saw that look on Mizuki's face...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to help. I have to help...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't care if Mizuki doesn't feel like talking, I don't want to see that expression again...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, Mizuki's my...)
